Added `spec.consistentHash` support to `TrafficPolicy` and committed the changes on branch `feat/consistent-hash`.

### Summary of Changes
1. **API Types & CRD Generation**:
   - Added [`ConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L616-L642) and its sub-types ([`HeaderHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L645-L658), [`HeaderRegexRewrite`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L661-L670), [`CookieHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L673-L694), [`CookieAttribute`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L697-L706), [`QueryParameterHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L709-L718), [`FilterStateHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L721-L730), and [`SourceIpHashPolicy`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L733-L737)) to [`TrafficPolicySpec`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/traffic_policy_types.go#L154-L156) with CEL validation enforcing that no other fields may be set when `disable` is `true`.
   - Regenerated deepcopy functions in [zz_generated.deepcopy.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/api/v1alpha1/kgateway/zz_generated.deepcopy.go) and CRD manifests in [gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/install/helm/kgateway-crds/templates/gateway.kgateway.dev_trafficpolicies.yaml).

2. **IR Construction, Route Translation & Policy Merging**:
   - Implemented [`consistentHashIR`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L21-L32), [`constructConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L115-L269), [`unionConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L275-L349), and [`applyConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go#L351-L364) in [consistent_hash.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash.go):
     - Defaults empty `consistentHash: {}` to a single `sourceIp` hash policy with `terminal=false`.
     - Suppresses hash policies when `disable: true`.
     - Builds hash policies in canonical type order (`headers`, `cookies`, `queryParameters`, `filterState`, `sourceIp`) and deduplicates entries by key (case-insensitive for headers while preserving first-occurrence casing).
     - Supports header `regexRewrite` and cookie `ttl` (both Go duration strings and integer seconds) as well as cookie `attributes`.
   - Wired construction, validation, equality, and per-route application in [constructor.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/constructor.go#L166-L169) and [traffic_policy_plugin.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/traffic_policy_plugin.go#L672-L674).
   - Implemented [`mergeConsistentHash`](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go#L627-L682) in [merge.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/merge.go) to union and deduplicate array fields in canonical order, retain the higher-priority policy's `sourceIp` value (even when unset), suppress lower-priority policies when `disable: true`, and record merge origins under `consistentHash`.
   - Added unit and CRD validation tests in [consistent_hash_test.go](file:///tmp/xhs-c6-host-o1z24xs2/pkg/kgateway/extensions2/plugins/trafficpolicy/consistent_hash_test.go).
